message: COLLEGE_EVENT: arm_a_refactor_plan_formalized | {"date": "2026-10-04", "plan_version": "v2.0", "location": ".agents/project/org/decisions/_drafts/arm_a_refactor_plan.md", "summary": "Formalized Arm A (Pure Quant) core refactor addressing 6 fundamental problems: vol suppression (1.73% vs 15-20%), composite stability bias (60% execution health), asymmetric risk (36% DD at 1.73% vol), turnover drag (53bps > 26bps gross), lagging regime model, statistical insignificance (t-stat 0.40).
